explication: BadgerDB is an embeddable Go key-value database. Applications open a DB, read and write through transactions, and retrieve ordered or versioned results with iterators; the documented storage design separates values into a value log and maintains keys in an LSM tree. The repository also provides streaming and offline backup/restore capabilities. The tree and README establish these product areas, but the sampled source is incomplete, so uncertain internal call wiring is omitted.
